summary: The CSS variables each component offers for customisation. A public variable has a single dash after the block (--sf-badge-color); the Framework never sets one, and reads it wherever a resting look is defined -- the base rule, sizes, appearances, schemes, statuses -- but not where a state is drawn (hover, focus, pressed, disabled, loading, an error), so states still show over a customised look. Set one on the component or on any ancestor. Every other --sf-<block>--* variable is internal: it may be renamed or removed in any release. A public variable is renamed or removed only through the change journal, as an attribute is.
